strings.DPHMainForm.Caption: Delphi Project Handoff - Experimental Software
strings.DPHMainForm.StatusLabel.Text: Choose a Delphi project to build its evidence-based handoff. DPH reads the selected files without changing them.
strings.DPHMainForm.InspectorPurpose.Text: Select an object to inspect its declaration, source evidence and connections. Begin with the Handoff dossier for project context.
Double-click an object in the left list, or follow an evidence link in the Handoff dossier.
strings.DPHMainForm.CardPurpose.Text: Explore this application through its learning route, project documents and screens. Select a topic to read what DPH found.
strings.DPHMainForm.CardFilter.TextPrompt: Find a learning topic, document or screen
strings.DPHMainForm.CardRole.TextPrompt: User role (blank means all; shared explanations always appear)
strings.DPHMainForm.CardDocumentLocationLabel.Te: Document location (choose which copy to read)
strings.DPHMainForm.CardEditorPurpose.Text: Teach one part of the selected application. Name the screen, field, error, question or report. Explain its purpose in plain language, give a worked example, mistakes to avoid, safe help and a practice question with its answer. Unknown is allowed when the author must answer. A new card links to the currently selected object, if any.
strings.DPHMainForm.Card_name_label.Text: Topic name: screen, field, exact error, question or report
strings.DPHMainForm.Card_role_label.Text: Who this helps: enter a user role, or All learners
strings.DPHMainForm.Card_meaning_label.Text: What it means and why the user needs it
strings.DPHMainForm.Card_example_label.Text: Worked example, valid input and units, or sample output explained
strings.DPHMainForm.Card_limits_label.Text: Rules, limits, permission requirements and common mistakes
strings.DPHMainForm.Card_help_label.Text: If the result differs: symptom, safe next step and who can help
strings.DPHMainForm.Card_practice_label.Text: Practice question or exercise and expected answer
strings.DPHMainForm.SetupPurpose.Text: Add attributed maintainer knowledge for the selected application. Document its purpose, procedures, expected results and unresolved questions. Link each claim to captured evidence and record named review separately.
strings.DPHMainForm.SetupMaterialLabel.Text: Other lesson material: choose a page below.
strings.DPHMainForm.AnalysisSettingsExpander.Tex: Source reading settings (only if the application author needs them)
strings.DPHMainForm.AnalysisSettingsTitle.Text: Source-reading settings (Debug, platform, extra defines, allowed dependency folders, text encoding)
strings.DPHMainForm.CodePageLabel.Text: Text encoding is only needed if an older source file displays incorrect characters. Leave 0 unless the application author supplies a Windows encoding number. Refresh lessons after changing these settings.
strings.DPHMainForm.TaskPurposeLabel.Text: Learn one task step by step. Read what must be ready, follow each action, and check the expected result. DPH presents instructions without running the selected application.
strings.DPHMainForm.TaskContextExpander.Text: Before you begin and task context
strings.DPHMainForm.TaskEditorPurpose.Text: Prepare instructions for this selected application. Supply a purpose, prerequisites, ordered actions and expected results. Keep each step, then Save task. Do not invent outcomes; enter Unknown where a result needs confirmation.
strings.DPHMainForm.TutorStepsLabel.Text: Steps in the order the learner follows
strings.DPHMainForm.TutorActionLabel.Text: What the learner does in this step
strings.DPHMainForm.TutorExpectedLabel.Text: What the learner should see after this step
strings.DPHMainForm.CoveragePurpose.Text: Coverage and gaps: separate static capture measures, human review and diagnostics. Select a diagnostic and click Inspect selected gap to read evidence and open matching source.
strings.DPHMainForm.ProjectSearchPurpose.Text: Search this application's Pascal source, project and form files, discovered guides and logs, captured evidence, and saved explanations. Enter up to twelve words. Select a result to read its matching text and source location. Results taken from files are clues, not proof of runtime behavior.
strings.DPHMainForm.ContinuityPurpose.Text: Review missing or renamed objects with linked knowledge. Click Find candidates, then select a proposed replacement. Inspect its Explain and Source views. Enter your reviewer name and approve only after establishing that it is the same logical object. Historical links and authored revisions are retained; knowledge content still needs separate review. Proposals never approve themselves.
strings.DPHMainForm.LifecyclePurpose.Text: Retention controls remove older cached view files, preserving immutable analysis facts and authored history. Set the number of recent generations, then Preview retention to inspect the policy. Keep current release protects the displayed generation under the label and reviewer you enter. Apply retention removes only eligible cached views; it keeps the baseline, published head, latest available generation, retained releases and linked review/screenshot evidence.
strings.DPHMainForm.ProjectsPurpose.Text: Known project databases. Select a row and click Open selected, or double-click it. Missing entries remain visible so you can locate a moved database. Remove from list forgets the entry; it never deletes a database or source project.
strings.DPHMainForm.ProjectMembersPurpose.Text: Select a captured project or output declaration to read its settings and source evidence below. Settings and main-source rows can describe the same application. Built outputs and services are unverified.
strings.DPHMainForm.BackupDialog.Title: Save a new project backup; keep its adjacent .views folder
strings.DPHMainForm.RestoreBackupDialog.Title: Select the backup database; its .views folder must be beside it
strings.DPHMainForm.RestoreDestinationDialog.Tit: Restore to a NEW database outside the selected source project
strings.DPHMainForm.ComparisonPurpose.Text: Compare saved generations of this selected project. First open Database tools and click Preview retention to find generation IDs and retained caches. Enter the Before ID here; After is the currently displayed generation. Click Compare. Select a result to read its evidence side by side. This compares captured fingerprints and structure; it does not reconstruct historical source text.
strings.DPHMainForm.ComparisonFilterEdit.TextPro: Optional name, path or change filter
strings.DPHMainForm.QualityPurpose.Text: Inspect routine metrics, potential duplicate bodies, missing incoming references, disconnected statements and call cycles. These are source-based investigation candidates. They do not prove unused code, equivalent behavior, runtime recursion or safe deletion. Select a row for evidence and explanation.
strings.DPHMainForm.HelpFallback.Lines.Strings.0: Build a source-backed maintenance handoff for an unfamiliar Delphi application.
strings.DPHMainForm.HelpFallback.Lines.Strings.2: 1. Click Open application at the top left and select its .dproj, .dpr or .groupproj file.
strings.DPHMainForm.HelpFallback.Lines.Strings.3: 2. Accept the proposed project file in Databases. For an existing file, click Open saved project.
strings.DPHMainForm.HelpFallback.Lines.Strings.4: 3. Handoff dossier summarizes purpose, startup, commands, data and open questions.
strings.DPHMainForm.HelpFallback.Lines.Strings.5: 4. Learning library lists topics from this application's guides and help.
strings.DPHMainForm.HelpFallback.Lines.Strings.6: 5. Screenshots shows available application images in fitted or native size.
strings.DPHMainForm.HelpFallback.Lines.Strings.8: Project map identifies forms, controls and connected actions. Application diagrams show supported connections.
strings.DPHMainForm.HelpFallback.Lines.Strings.9: DPH does not invent screenshots when an application provides none.

strings.DPHMainForm.BreadcrumbLabel.Text: Choose the application you want to learn, or open its saved lessons.
strings.DPHMainForm.GraphLegend.Text: Blue: direct connection in the project files. Orange dashed: possible connection that needs interpretation. Select a box to see its details.
strings.DPHMainForm.GraphPurpose.Text: Start with the screen map to see possible routes through this application. Select a screen or connection to learn more.
strings.DPHMainForm.ScreenWarning.Text: Approximate design-time reconstruction. Runtime layout, styles and custom painting are unobserved.
strings.DPHMainForm.ScreenshotCaption.TextPrompt: Capture date, environment and what this image shows
strings.DPHMainForm.ScreenshotHelp.Text: Select a form on the left. The preview starts at Native pixels so text stays readable; scroll to see the rest. Choose Fit for an overview or use the zoom slider for another size. This is a reconstruction of saved .fmx or .dfm controls, not a running screen; custom drawing and live data may differ.
strings.DPHMainForm.DetailsTitle.Text: Statements, properties and evidence. Select an Explorer object, then a row below. The right pane explains the selected row and its source. Property values are serialized overrides; framework defaults are not inferred.
strings.DPHMainForm.DetailsSourceButton.Text: Open matching source for selected row
strings.DPHMainForm.KnowledgeSectionLabel.Text: New section: stable ID assigned on Save
strings.DPHMainForm.KnowledgeWarning.Text: Human knowledge is attributed. Save creates a pending revision. Verify records your review of the selected generation; parser success cannot approve it.
strings.DPHMainForm.LayoutPurpose.Text: Captured layout rules with alignment, anchors and spacing explanations. Resize examples are educational; target runtime geometry is unobserved.

strings.DPHMainForm.LayoutStatus.Text: Open a project capture to begin.

strings.DPHMainForm.DatabaseInventoryStatus.Text: Open a captured project to begin.

sources.DPHMainForm.ContinuityPurpose.Text: Review missing or renamed objects with linked knowledge. Click Find candidates, then select a proposed replacement. Inspect its Explain and Source views. Enter your reviewer name and approve only after establishing that it is the same logical object. Historical links and authored revisions are retained; knowledge content still needs separate review. Proposals never approve themselves.
sources.DPHMainForm.LifecyclePurpose.Text: Retention controls remove older cached view files, preserving immutable analysis facts and authored history. Set the number of recent generations, then Preview retention to inspect the policy. Keep current release protects the displayed generation under the label and reviewer you enter. Apply retention removes only eligible cached views; it keeps the baseline, published head, latest available generation, retained releases and linked review/screenshot evidence.
sources.DPHMainForm.ProjectsPurpose.Text: Known project databases. Select a row and click Open selected, or double-click it. Missing entries remain visible so you can locate a moved database. Remove from list forgets the entry; it never deletes a database or source project.
